nodes.title: POS PROMPT 1
widgets_values: A young woman with long brown hair is positioned on a dark couch in a softly lit room. A single, sharp ray of sunlight illuminates parts of the scene. She is holding a silver smartphone with both hands, positioning it directly in front of her face to completely obscure it from the camera's view, mimicking a mirror selfie pose. She is wearing a black lace bralette and a watch on her left wrist, which catches the light.

nodes.title: POS PROMPT 1
widgets_values: She shifts slightly, drawing one leg closer to her body, causing the shadows to move. Her posture is relaxed, leaning into the couch. Throughout this movement, her hands remain firmly in place, keeping the smartphone held steady as a perfect mask, ensuring her face is never, at any point, visible. The phone's back reflects a muted sheen.

nodes.title: POS PROMPT 1
widgets_values: The woman tilts her head slightly to the side, a quiet, contemplative gesture. The smartphone moves precisely with her head, maintaining the complete concealment of her face. The angle change causes the sunlight to highlight the texture of the lace on her bralette and the curve of her shoulder, while her identity remains a complete mystery behind the device.

nodes.title: POS PROMPT 1
widgets_values: She leans forward just a fraction, bringing the phone-obscured upper part of her body closer to the viewer. The phone remains locked in its hiding position, a modern shield. After a moment, she settles back into her initial pose, the phone still perfectly hiding her face as the scene holds and then slowly fades to black, leaving her anonymity intact.
